set_aside.subject: ownership and transaction of implicit manual-budget creation
set_aside.text: “capability:project_tracking.list_project_progress … first creates the empty manual budget version” conflicts with State 3: “module:budget_management owns … the manual budget” and module:project_tracking “Must not own … budget editing.”
set_aside.question: Which named capability owns this creation, and is creation plus its budget.manual_version_create audit committed atomically with the progress-list read or in a separate transaction?
options: project_tracking.list_project_progress creates and audits the version in its own transaction
project_tracking delegates to budget_management.ensure_manual_budget, which commits before the progress read
a new budget_management capability participates in the progress-list transaction
set_aside.default_guess: Delegate to budget_management.ensure_manual_budget before listing progress.

witness.initial: An archived project has no manual BudgetVersion and has progress records; persistence can fail while those records are subsequently read.
events: The empty manual budget and its required audit are created.
Reading the progress records then fails.
outcomes: Creation and audit were in the list transaction, so the failure rolls them back and the caller receives 500.
ensure_manual_budget committed separately, so the caller receives 500 but the empty budget and audit remain.
witness.observer: The staff member or administrator who retries and then reads the budget or audit history.

set_aside.unit: context: agreement of the earlier states' texts with this state
set_aside.subject: revocation observed by an already-authenticated in-flight request
set_aside.text: “Immediate means every request authenticated after the revocation commits observes it” leaves requests authenticated before the commit uncovered, while A11 still says a revoked grant, credential, viewer or session “blocks the next authorization check immediately” and A4 says assignment revocation blocks the next project-scoped authorization check.
set_aside.question: Must a request whose session was authenticated before revocation, but whose project authorization check occurs after the revocation commits, observe the revocation?
options: Yes; every authorization check reads current revocation state regardless of when request authentication occurred
No; a request authenticated before the commit may continue using its previously resolved actor/access state
set_aside.default_guess: Require the post-commit authorization check to observe the revocation.

witness.initial: An operator has an active staff session and an active assignment to project P.
events: The operator's request resolves its staff session before revocation.
An administrator revokes the operator's assignment to P and commits.
The operator's in-flight request performs its project authorization check after that commit.
outcomes: Under A11/A4, authorization observes the revoked assignment and refuses the request.
Under the new request-authentication wording, the already-authenticated request may proceed and read or mutate P.
witness.observer: The operator receives either the project result or an access refusal; project users may also observe a mutation if it proceeds.
